You can take a person’s fortune away with your powers over fate. Attempt a [[/act steal dc=will]] check from up to 30 feet against the Will DC of a target you can see.

Success You gain a +1 status bonus to your next attack roll until the end of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.9oudKdyeUQDG5my4]{Effect: Thief of Luck (Bonus)}

Critical Success As Success, but the target suffers a -1 status penalty to their next attack roll until the end of their next turn, and then they become immune to the status penalty from Thief of Luck for 24 hours. @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.7qc3wWH8lQMi6cvZ]{Effect: Thief of Luck (Penalty)}

The bonus and penalty increase to 2 when you reach 5th level and 3 when you reach 13th level.
